description: Search the live web with DeepSeek's search engine. Returns ranked results with a model-ready summary per result (capped at 800 chars by default). rerank_score ranges 0-3; >= 1.5 is high quality. Use this to discover sources; then call deepseek_fetch on a URL for the full page, or use deepseek_research to do both in one step. The query is limited to 128 characters including filters and supports operators: "exact phrase", -term, -"phrase".

after.description: Only pages dated after this: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Only pages dated before this: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

include_content.description: Also return each page's text (truncated). Costs no extra request but uses much more context.

localization.description: Optional IP address used to localize results.

original_question.description: The user's original question, in their words. Improves ranking; trimmed to 128 chars.

query.description: Search query, max 128 chars after filters are added.

sites.description: Only return results from these domains, e.g. ["github.com"].

name: deepseek_search
title: DeepSeek web search
